title: Gamma-positivity for octopuses: a bijective proof
summary: Chapoton introduced an interesting family of polytopes called arbor polytopes, where a polytope $\mathcal{Q}_τ$ is associated to any arbor $τ$. Chapoton conjectured that the polynomial $h(τ)$ which counts lattice points in $\mathcal{Q}_τ$ by number of nonzero entries is palindromic and unimodal. Athanasiadis, Xiao, and Yan recently proved that $h(τ)$ is gamma-positive for a certain class of arbors they call octopuses. Since their proof was computational, they asked for one that is bijective.
